name: DOOMTRAIN
description:
About This Game

-- Hell has gone CORPORATE! --

Run by evil executives, the demons living there have been forced into eternal overtime. Armed with the powerful DOOMTRAIN, you must free Hell from its corporate oppressors and restore balance. Build a thriving medieval steampunk town, upgrade your DOOMTRAIN's engine and turrets, unionize the oppressed demon workers, and take down the corporate overlords of DemonCorp!

-- BUILD YOUR MEDIEVAL STEAMPUNK TOWN --

Construct a thriving town in an idyllic realm to support your campaign against DemonCorp. Build homes for your villagers and production buildings to generate the resources needed for your unionization effort. Manage resource flows to keep your people happy while crafting powerful parts to upgrade the DOOMTRAIN and its arsenal.

-- DESTROY CORPORATE WITH THE DOOMTRAIN --

Send your armored train through a portal straight into DemonCorp headquarters. Equip devastating turrets with multiple upgrade tiers, each unlocking unique mechanics and powerful abilities. Deploy defensive hazards to hold back the demon hordes while your weapons tear through endless waves of enemies.

-- UNIONIZE THE DEMON WORKERS --

Push deeper into DemonCorp's floors to rescue heroes, gather rare upgrade materials, and defeat evil executive bosses. As you clear out each department, unionize the oppressed demon underlings and free them from mandatory unpaid overtime. Rescued demons will join your town as citizens, bringing their own unique buildings and resources to expand your town.

-- DEFEAT THE CORPORATE OVERLORDS --

Battle through increasingly dangerous floors of DemonCorp headquarters. Face waves of corrupted corporate demons trying to destroy the DOOMTRAIN. Challenge executive bosses in epic encounters. Unionize Hell one department at a time and restore balance to both realms.

-- TRAILER CREDITS --

Offical Game Trailer made by Michael Berardini (@mbirdini on socials).
